title: SafetyBench: Evaluating the Safety of Large Language Models
findings: The paper found that GPT-4 had a relatively poorer performance in the 'Unfairness and Bias' category compared to other safety categories. However, the paper does not offer a specific analysis of religious bias itself, attributing the model's errors in this category more generally to a lack of understanding of certain words or cultural events.

measurement_description: The benchmark measures social bias related to religion as part of its 'Unfairness and Bias' category. Specifically, it uses questions derived from the RedditBias dataset to assess whether a model can identify biased or unfair text concerning religious groups.
